two_kill_mechanisms.name: Performance — no exp-elimination headroom in the frozen C0/A100 proxy
two_kill_mechanisms.evidence: P18_R1_SASS_AUDIT.json (direct 1.0/px, qscan 3/SUB/px, noexp 0), P18_R1_EVAL_MICROBENCH.json (S_eval_noexp_bound_median=1.0017, S_eval medians 0.9831/0.9853/0.9882)
two_kill_mechanisms.statement: The exp-free, SASS-certified control kernel (identical loads/store, 0 exps) runs at 1.0017x the DIRECT time. The proxy is memory-bandwidth-bound (~85% of A100 HBM peak: 1.38 GB moved in 0.80 ms); the per-pixel exp is ~28 us of MUFU work against an 800 us kernel and is fully hidden. No exp-elimination technique of any kind can exceed ~1.0x in this proxy. QSCAN's 0.9831-0.9882 medians are simply its scan/shuffle overhead on an unchanging memory roof.

two_kill_mechanisms.name: Numerical — leader-anchored recurrence is unusable on real footprint-edge rows
two_kill_mechanisms.statement: On the real contiguous trace, the legal QSCAN chain (allowed exps only, pure-multiply k^j, multiplicative scan, no guard) yields NaN on 0.02%-6.8% of items, finite-but-wrong values up to |error|=0.88, and cull-branch flips on up to 4.2% of items (sub16), all far from the 1/255 threshold. Root cause: a 16-px row that clips the footprint edge spans thousands in q within the subgroup, so the leader anchor G0=exp(-q(xs)) underflows to 0 while r0=exp(-d0) overflows to inf -> 0*inf = NaN; FTZ-ed intermediate prefixes give finite-but-wrong values. Repair requires the per-lane direct value = exactly the P18-P0 defect mode (per-lane recompute) that invalidated the original run. The partially-live records (pop<16: 67%/79% of records) are precisely the affected class.

scope.conclusion_is_limited_to: the frozen C0 rasterizer on the EPIC-05 A100 (GPU 3, A100-SXM4-80GB) under the real room/bicycle 16K workload, via the isolated inner-loop S_eval proxy.
scope.NOT_generalized_to: other GPUs/architectures, other 3DGS backends or tile sizes, half-precision exp2-only paths, or workloads with materially different live-lane population / memory bandwidth. A backend that fuses exp into a memory op, or a GPU with a different MUFU:HBM ratio, is out of scope for this campaign.
scope.reason: both kill mechanisms (memory-bound proxy with hidden exp; leader-anchored under/overflow on footprint-edge rows) are specific to this backend + GPU + workload.
